name: NYC Air Quality and Health Outcomes Analysis
description: An integrated analysis of air pollution levels and respiratory health outcomes across New York City boroughs. This project combines NYC Air Quality surveillance data with EnviroAtlas BenMAP health impact estimates to examine correlations between pollutant concentrations (NO2, O3, PM2.5) and acute respiratory symptoms at the borough level.
